label: D1 after the previous trial ended in S2 (sparse, ~8% of such steps)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and only when the previous trial reached S2. Every dev activation is either preceded by an S2 trial (82%) or is on the window-first trial where prev_state is unknown (18%). It never fires after an S1 trial, and never late in the episode (trials 90-99 are about 0). Within the condition it is sparse: precision is about 8%, recall 100%. The things I tested that might pick out which S2-preceded D1 steps fire (previous reward, transition, upcoming switch or choice, value or policy-logit bins, episode trial) did not raise F1 above about 0.17. The strongest activations come after an unrewarded common S2 trial, mostly when the agent then switches to a1, but that subset captures only about 20% of the mass. Activations are more likely at mid-range value and with an uncertain policy logit (|choice| < ~8). The predicate uses only observed variables (the previously reached state is visible before D1).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
